prompt.main_subject: An adult woman in a thick beige knit sweater with long wet dark hair walks through neon rain.
prompt.composition_elements: Following handheld POV shot; focus shifts from blur to sharp as she looks back, taps the lens once, walks away, waves, and leaves an empty street for the final two seconds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Rainy-night street lamps and neon signage with high noise, motion blur, compression artifacts, electrical hiss, and rain ambience.

technical_specs.camera: Deliberately degraded 2007 Nokia-style phone simulation, 9:16 handheld POV, single small timestamp overlay.
technical_specs.motion: 15-second sequence with focus shift, friendly lens tap, farewell walk, and held empty street.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: 15 seconds, 9:16 vertical screen, deliberately mimicking low-quality 2007 mobile-phone recording: handheld POV, high noise, motion blur, digital compression distortion, and a small top-left 2007-style timestamp. From 0-5 seconds, follow an adult woman in a thick beige sweater from behind through a rainy neon street; her long hair is wet from drizzle. From 5-9 seconds, she stops and looks back as focus shifts from blurry to sharp, gives a small friendly smile, and tucks wet hair behind her ear. From 9-13 seconds, she approaches, lightly taps the lens once with one fingertip, creating a brief harmless vibration, then steps back with hands in pockets beneath neon backlight. From 13-15 seconds, she turns, walks into rain and fog, gives one final wave, and the camera holds on the empty street while digital noise consumes the frame. Rain ambience and faint phone-recording electrical noise throughout. No subtitles, external watermark, or modern UI elements.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized interaction, minor, modern interface, external watermark, garbled text, distorted face, extra fingers, deformed, plastic skin
